_comment: Shared cross-back-end conformance fixture for the `conditional`/`when` guard decision layer. The SAME scenarios are asserted against dispatcher/claude-agent-sdk/src/conditional.ts (which realizes this decision layer live in the hybrid-staged executor) and a mirrored, conformance-only Rust module in dispatcher/claude-code-cli/src/conditional.rs. A semantic drift between the two back-ends' understanding of the closed guard vocabulary (on_failure / on_flag / on_missing) or the bounded repair loop fails whichever suite moved away from this file.

guard_scenarios.name: repair-shaped on_failure with a failed target folds into a repair turn
repair-shaped on_failure with a succeeded target has nothing to repair
on_flag guard true runs the guarded step
on_flag guard false skips the guarded step
cascade-optional: on_missing runs when the upstream artifact was never produced
cascade-optional: on_missing skips once the upstream artifact is already present

repair_loop_scenarios.name: single-attempt bound recovers on the first try
single-attempt bound exhausts without recovering (caller loud-fails)
multi-attempt bound recovers on the second try
